relationships.subject: S1HL glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The acute pain condition elicits increased excitation from Glu<sup>S1HL</sup> neurons to spleen-projecting ACh<sup>DMV</sup> neurons and increased the proportion of splenic T<sub>H</sub>2 immune cells.

relationships.subject: CeA GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The chronic pain condition increased inhibition from GABA<sup>CeA</sup> neurons to spleen-projecting ACh<sup>DMV</sup> neurons and decreased splenic T<sub>H</sub>2 immune cells.

relationships.subject: spleen-projecting DMV acetylcholinergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: acetylcholinergic neurons in the dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus (ACh<sup>DMV</sup>) directly innervate the spleen

key_findings: Acute neuropathic pain increases S1HL glutamatergic drive onto spleen-projecting DMV acetylcholinergic neurons and raises splenic TH2 immune cells.
Chronic neuropathic pain instead increases CeA GABAergic inhibition of the same DMV neurons and decreases splenic TH2 immune cells.
